verdict.rationale: Mem0 Open Source runs the same memory engine on your own infrastructure, so you "own the stack, the data, and every component" and effectively choose where data lives by self-hosting the Docker stack. The evidence shows no region or residency selection for the hosted Platform, so this choice only exists through the self-hosting route. Missing for 10: region/residency selection on the managed Platform, documented data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, independent corroboration.
